meno_menopause_support.name: Menopause Support
meno_menopause_support.key: 500 mg EstroG‑100 blend, 250 mg ashwagandha, 80 mg black cohosh. Peri: 500 mg each EstroG‑100 and ashwagandha, 100 mg milk thistle
meno_menopause_support.src: Menopause Support sell sheet ND564 Rev. 8/24 (Dropbox NutriDyn Marketing Materials id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAAtb9A, read into scratchpad labels/labels.json): per 1 tablet Estro G-100 blend (Angelica gigas nakai root extract, Cynanchum wilfordii root extract, Phlomis umbrosa root extract) 500 mg, ashwagandha root powder 250 mg, black cohosh root powder 80 mg; 90 servings; directions one tablet daily with food at the same time of day; caution: not for pregnancy or nursing, not recommended with known or suspected estrogen-dependent cancer. Same amounts in products DB R264L (Pendulum chart, catalog ND143 10/1/26). Size R264L 90T from price list ND144 10/1/26. URL from an earlier NutriDyn visit brief. Dose bar is the label direction; the morning slot in Your daily rhythm is plan timing. PeriMenopause Support (the other box the provider can tick, for a period in the last 12 months): sell sheet ND565 Rev. 8/24 (Dropbox NutriDyn Marketing Materials id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAAtRRA, read into scratchpad labels/labels.json): per 1 tablet Estro G-100 blend 500 mg, ashwagandha root powder 500 mg, milk thistle seed powder 100 mg; 30 servings; same directions (one tablet daily with food at the same time of day) and the same pregnancy, nursing and estrogen-dependent-cancer caution. Size R199 30T from price list ND144 10/1/26. Stage rule (period within the last year: PeriMenopause Support; longer: Menopause Support) from Asher's Menopause Map.

meno_mag_calm_pro.name: Mag Calm Pro
meno_mag_calm_pro.key: 200 mg magnesium (as malate), 2 g myo‑inositol, 500 mg taurine, 100 mg L‑theanine, 5 mg vitamin B6
meno_mag_calm_pro.src: Mag Calm Pro sell sheet ND1075 Rev. 11/24 (labels.json): per scoop (4.13 g) vitamin B6 (as pyridoxal-5-phosphate) 5 mg, magnesium (as dimagnesium malate) 200 mg, myo-inositol 2 g, taurine 500 mg, L-theanine (Suntheanine) 100 mg; about 60 servings, 247.8 g; directions 1 scoop with 6 oz water 1-2 times daily. Same amounts in products DB R2122 (Metagenics chart). URL from an earlier NutriDyn visit brief. Dose bar: '1 to 2 scoops daily, each in 6 oz water' restates the label direction; 'try bedtime' and the bedtime slot in Your daily rhythm are plan timing, not label text.

meno_d3_5000_k2.name: D3 5000 with K2
meno_d3_5000_k2.key: 5,000 IU (125 mcg) vitamin D3, 60 mcg vitamin K2 (MK‑7), 15 mcg vitamin K1
meno_d3_5000_k2.src: NutriDyn sell sheet 'D3 5000 with K2 SS ND382' Rev. 6/24, Supplement Facts panel (Dropbox Marketing Materials id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAAnbug, as read for the thyroid sheet, products.d/thyroid.json): serving 1 softgel, 60 servings; vitamin D3 125 mcg (5,000 IU), vitamin K1 15 mcg, vitamin K2 as MK-7 (MenaQ7) 60 mcg; directions 'Take one softgel daily with food'; label warnings: contains vitamin D at a level that exceeds the adult tolerable upper intake level, use should be short-term and include regular monitoring of vitamin D levels, and vitamin K2 is not recommended for patients on blood-thinning medications. Same amounts in products DB R197 (Designs for Health and Ortho Molecular charts, catalog ND143 10/1/26); size 60S (60 softgels, also printed on the bottle photo). Dose bar: '1 softgel daily' and 'with a meal' are the label direction; 'test first' (a vitamin D blood test) follows the label's monitoring warning and the thyroid sheet's 'only if your level is low' framing; the evening-meal slot in Your daily rhythm is plan timing, not label text.

meno_ultrabiotic_womens.name: UltraBiotic Women’s
meno_ultrabiotic_womens.key: 25 billion CFU (live bacteria, at manufacture) from 9 strains: 7 Lactobacillus and 2 Bacillus
meno_ultrabiotic_womens.src: UltraBiotic Women's sell sheet ND1053 Rev. 1/25, opened 2026-11-03 (Dropbox NutriDyn Marketing Materials id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAAwfzA): serving 2 capsules, 30 servings; strains L. acidophilus La-14, L. rhamnosus HN001, L. rhamnosus Rosell-11 + L. helveticus Rosell-52 (Lacidofil), Bacillus subtilis HU58, L. reuteri 1E1, Bacillus coagulans SC208, L. gasseri LG36, L. salivarius LS33; amounts 9 + 6 + 4 + 2 + 2 + 1 + 0.5 + 0.5 = 25 billion CFU at time of manufacture (text extraction split names and amounts; the total matches the products DB R177 Metagenics-chart read: 9 strains, 25 billion CFU per 2 capsules). Claims on the sheet: supports a healthy vaginal microbiome, supports a healthy gut microbiome. Directions take two capsules daily. No verified product-page URL, so the link falls back to catalog search. Dose bar: '2 capsules daily' is the label direction; 'same time each day' is a soft cue and the bedtime slot in Your daily rhythm is plan timing, not label text. 'at time of manufacture' is the label's own qualifier for the 25 billion CFU. Photo: R177 is the 115x160 catalog thumbnail (below print quality). The print master 'UltraBiotic Womens PC ND1010.pdf' could not be downloaded from this session; the only original found (688x952, Gmail 'Fwd: Bag Stuffer' 2023-08-15, ND1106 Life University bag insert) shows the pre-rebrand label, so it was not used.

meno_creatine.name: Creatine Powder
meno_creatine.dosesub: in 8 to 16 oz of any drink
meno_creatine.src: products DB R258 (Thorne chart, catalog ND143 10/1/26): creatine monohydrate 5 g per scoop, 100 servings, 505 g; directions mix 1 scoop in 8-16 ounces of water or your favorite beverage. Unflavored per the tub photo. URL from the repo creatine blast (blasts/2026-11-16-creatine-plus-training.html). Dose bar is the label direction; the morning slot in Your daily rhythm is plan timing. Photo: R258 is a 768x780 Lanczos enlargement of a 157x160 thumbnail (below print quality; print master Creatine Powder PC ND1311 / BS ND1312 in Dropbox could not be downloaded from this session).
